name: Pension Thurnerhof
beschreibung: The Pension Thurnerhof is located in Söll, a village in the Tiroler Unterland with access to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area. The guesthouse offers bed and breakfast or half board in simple, well-kept accommodation. Guests will find informal accommodation close to the center with access to hiking and ski routes.
